description: Defines the IsochronousClockModel class for modeling an isochronous data stream using timestamps, including methods for converting between position and time, handling clock drift, and maintaining state. It is part of the aaudio namespace and references external utilities like Histogram and AudioClock.

classes.name: IsochronousClockModel
classes.description: A class for modeling an isochronous data stream using timestamps to predict stream position and timing, handling clock drift, and providing conversion methods.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the clock model at a given nanoTime.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the clock model at a given nanoTime.

methods.name: isStarting
methods.description: Returns true if the model is in startup phase.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Returns true if the model is actively producing valid results.

methods.name: processTimestamp
methods.description: Processes a timestamp with frame position and nanoTime.

methods.name: setSampleRate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate of the stream.

methods.name: setPositionAndTime
methods.description: Sets the current position and time of the stream.

methods.name: setFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Sets the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: convertPositionToTime
methods.description: Converts a frame position to an estimated time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: convertPositionToLatestTime
methods.description: Converts a frame position to the latest estimated time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: convertTimeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a time in nanoseconds to an estimated frame position.

methods.name: convertLatestTimeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a time in nanoseconds to an estimated frame position, considering latest possible time.

methods.name: convertDeltaPositionToTime
methods.description: Converts a delta in frames to a duration in nanoseconds.

methods.name: convertDeltaTimeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a duration in nanoseconds to a delta in frames.
